name: Tong Zhu (朱桐)
description:
I'm working at Shanghai AI Lab, focusing on model architecture research. Before that, I obtained my PhD degree at [Soochow University](http://eng.suda.edu.cn/), advised by [Wenliang Chen](https://chen-wenliang.github.io/). I received my B.S. degree from [Guizhou University](https://www.gzu.edu.cn/en/).
My research journey has shifted several times, spanning information extraction (2019–2023), large language model pre-training and applications (2023–2025), and model architecture (2025–present).
As model capabilities have improved, I have also become increasingly interested in AI-powered interactive entertainment and have helped build many demos (see https://wortou.ai). Among those projects, our [Tenure Track Simulator](https://tenure-plus.feedscription.com/) has gained nearly 88K peak DAU (900K UV in total) and consumed 350B tokens (cutoff date: 2026.1.24).
